import _thread
import re
import sys
size, workers = int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2])
pattern = re.compile('a*$')
text = 'a' * size
gate = _thread.allocate_lock()
gate.acquire()
done = [_thread.allocate_lock() for _ in range(workers)]
for lock in done:
    lock.acquire()
results = [False] * workers
def worker(index):
    try:
        gate.acquire()
        gate.release()
        for _ in range(128 // workers):
            assert pattern.fullmatch(text).end() == size
        results[index] = True
    except BaseException:
        results[index] = False
    finally:
        done[index].release()
for index in range(workers):
    _thread.start_new_thread(worker, (index,))
gate.release()
for lock in done:
    lock.acquire()
assert all(results)
print(workers)
